entities.name: Jacques-Martin Hotteterre
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jacques-Martin Hotteterre, also known as Jacques Martin or Jacques Hotteterre, was a French composer and flautist, instrument maker and teacher, who was the most celebrated of a family of wind instrument makers and wind performers.
